achievements.name: The Fool
achievements.description: Become a mercenary.

steps: Finish the prologue / Act 1 until V is operating as a merc in Night City.
Completing the early story beat that puts you on the streets unlocks this.

achievements.name: The Lovers
achievements.description: Steal the Relic.

steps: Progress the main job through The Heist.
Steal the Relic during the Konpeki Plaza heist sequence.

achievements.name: Right Back At Ya
achievements.description: Kill or incapacitate an enemy who threw a grenade at you.

steps: When an enemy throws a grenade, shoot them before it detonates (or kill them immediately after).
Any weapon works — pistols/SMGs are easiest in close fights.

achievements.name: The Wheel of Fortune
achievements.description: Interrogate Anders Hellman.

steps: Continue the main quest until you capture Anders Hellman.
Complete the interrogation scene with him.

achievements.name: Stanislavski's Method
achievements.description: Use a dialogue option related to V's life path 10 times.

steps: In dialogue, pick options tagged with your life path (Nomad / Streetkid / Corpo) when they appear.
Use 10 life-path dialogue choices across the campaign — early gigs and main jobs offer plenty.

achievements.name: The Hermit
achievements.description: Find Alt Cunningham.

steps: Follow the main quest into Beyond the Blackwall / Alt Cunningham story beats.
Complete the mission where you find Alt Cunningham.

achievements.name: True Soldier
achievements.description: Kill or incapacitate 300 enemies using ranged weapons.

steps: Kill or incapacitate enemies with guns, tech, or smart weapons (not melee).
300 kills is cumulative — story + gigs + NCPD scanners will cover it naturally.

achievements.name: The High Priestess
achievements.description: Talk with Hanako Arasaka.

steps: Progress the main quest until Hanako Arasaka contacts you.
Complete the meeting / talk with Hanako (Nocturne Op55N1 lead-in).

achievements.name: Full Body Conversion
achievements.description: Install at least one implant in each system and body part.

steps: Visit a ripperdoc and install at least one cyberware piece in every slot category (Operating System, Frontal Cortex, Arms, Skeleton, Nervous System, Integumentary, Face, Hands, Circulatory, Legs).
Empty/default starter pieces may not count — buy and install a new implant per system.

achievements.name: Christmas Tree Attack
achievements.description: Complete a Breach Protocol with a minimum of 3 daemons uploaded.

steps: During the related gig/mission, use the environment hazard / explosive set piece.
Kill the required enemies with that Christmas-tree / festive trap moment.

achievements.name: Legend of The Afterlife
achievements.description: Reach max Street Cred.

steps: Raise Street Cred by finishing gigs, NCPD Scanner Hustles, and side jobs.
Street Cred max is 50 — check the character menu progress bar.

achievements.name: Life of the Road
achievements.description: Complete Panam Palmer's storyline.

steps: Follow and finish the full romance/side storyline: Panam Palmer's storyline.
Keep calling/texting the character until their quest chain ends.

achievements.name: Gun Fu
achievements.description: Kill or incapacitate 3 enemies in quick succession with a revolver or pistol in close combat.

steps: Use a pistol or revolver at close range.
Kill/incapacitate 3 enemies in rapid succession (Kerenzikov / Sandevistan helps).

achievements.name: The World
achievements.description: Complete the main storyline.

steps: Follow and finish the full romance/side storyline: the main storyline.
Keep calling/texting the character until their quest chain ends.

achievements.name: Bushido and Chill
achievements.description: Watch Bushido X with Rogue.

steps: Progress Rogue’s side content / Afterlife romance-adjacent hangout.
Watch Bushido X with Rogue when the scene is offered.

achievements.name: True Warrior
achievements.description: Kill or incapacitate 100 enemies using melee weapons.

steps: Kill or incapacitate 100 enemies with melee weapons (katanas, bats, fists, mantis blades, etc.).
Stack with Blunt/Blade builds or finishers in crowded NCPD fights.

achievements.name: Master Crafter
achievements.description: Craft 3 Legendary items.

steps: Unlock Legendary crafting perks / upgrade components as needed.
Craft 3 separate Legendary items at the crafting panel (weapons or clothing).

achievements.name: Judy vs Night City
achievements.description: Complete Judy Alvarez's storyline.

steps: Follow and finish the full romance/side storyline: Judy Alvarez's storyline.
Keep calling/texting the character until their quest chain ends.

achievements.name: Two Heads, One Bullet
achievements.description: Kill or incapacitate 2 enemies with the same sniper rifle shot.

steps: Use a sniper rifle on two enemies lined up (head/body aligned).
One shot must kill/incapacitate both — Tech snipers that pierce or careful positioning work.

achievements.name: To Protect and Serve
achievements.description: Complete River Ward's storyline.

steps: Follow and finish the full romance/side storyline: River Ward's storyline.
Keep calling/texting the character until their quest chain ends.

achievements.name: The Quick and the Dead
achievements.description: Kill or incapacitate 50 enemies while time is slowed.

steps: Equip Sandevistan or Kerenzikov (or similar time-slow cyberware/perks).
Kill/incapacitate 50 enemies while time is slowed — cumulative across encounters.

achievements.name: All the President's Men
achievements.description: Save President Myers.

steps: Play Phantom Liberty and progress the main path involving President Myers.
Complete the sequence where you save President Myers.

achievements.name: Arachnophobia
achievements.description: Defeat the Chimera.

steps: In Phantom Liberty, reach the Chimera boss encounter.
Defeat the Chimera to unlock the achievement.

achievements.name: I Am The Law
achievements.description: Complete all Cyberpsycho Sightings.

steps: Complete every Cyberpsycho Sighting (Regina calls / map markers).
Neutralize each cyberpsycho and send evidence where required.

achievements.name: The Wandering Fool
achievements.description: Find all the tarot graffiti for the job Fool on the Hill.

steps: Start/progress the "Fool on the Hill" job involving tarot graffiti.
Photograph/find every tarot graffiti location on the map.

achievements.name: Ten out of Ten
achievements.description: Reach the max level in any skill.

steps: Invest perk points / use skills until any one skill tree hits maximum level.
Focus one tree (e.g. Cool or Body) rather than spreading points.

achievements.name: Breathtaking
achievements.description: Collect all items that once belonged to Johnny Silverhand.

steps: Collect every item that belonged to Johnny Silverhand (weapons, clothes, items tied to his quests).
Finish related side content and stash checks until the set is complete.

achievements.name: The Sun
achievements.description: Become a legend of the Afterlife.

steps: Build Street Cred and finish the main story on the path that makes V a legend of the Afterlife.
Choose the solo/Afterlife legend ending at the finale.

achievements.name: V for Vendetta
achievements.description: After reviving with Second Heart, kill or incapacitate the enemy who killed you within 5 seconds.

steps: Install the Second Heart cyberware (Circulatory system).
Die to an enemy, revive via Second Heart, then kill that same enemy within 5 seconds.

achievements.name: The Star
achievements.description: Leave Night City with the Aldecaldos.

steps: Complete Panam's storyline and stay allied with the Aldecaldos.
Choose the ending that leaves Night City with the Aldecaldos.
warnings: Aldecaldos ending — requires Panam/Aldecaldos relationship progress.

achievements.name: To Bad Decisions!
achievements.description: Complete Kerry Eurodyne's storyline.

steps: Follow and finish the full romance/side storyline: Kerry Eurodyne's storyline.
Keep calling/texting the character until their quest chain ends.

achievements.name: Spin Doctor
achievements.description: Complete "Run This Town".

steps: Progress Judy / related side content until the braindance edit opportunity.
Complete the braindance editing sequence successfully.

achievements.name: Temperance
achievements.description: Let Johnny Silverhand keep your body.

steps: Reach the ending choice involving Johnny Silverhand.
Choose to let Johnny keep V’s body (Temperance ending).

achievements.name: Must Be Rats
achievements.description: Perform the Distract Enemies quickhack 30 times without drawing attention to yourself.

steps: Equip a cyberdeck with the Distract Enemies quickhack.
Use Distract Enemies 30 times while remaining undetected (stealth / remote camera play).

achievements.name: Easy Come, Easy Go
achievements.description: Steal the Arasaka medical truck or deliver 10 vehicles to El Capitan.

steps: Either steal the Arasaka medical truck during the related Phantom Liberty / story opportunity,
Or deliver 10 vehicles to El Capitan via his vehicle delivery gigs.

achievements.name: King of Wands
achievements.description: Take Songbird to the stars.

steps: In Phantom Liberty, progress Songbird’s story to the ending choice.
Choose the path that takes Songbird to the stars / orbital outcome.

achievements.name: The Jungle
achievements.description: Complete all gigs and NCPD Scanner Hustles in Santo Domingo.

steps: Open the map and clear every Gig and NCPD Scanner Hustle marker in Santo Domingo.
Use MapGenie / in-game filters — greyed icons mean unfinished.

achievements.name: Dirty Deeds
achievements.description: Complete every Gig in Dogtown.

steps: Open the Journal gigs list filtered to Dogtown.
Complete every gig available in Dogtown (Phantom Liberty).

achievements.name: Mean Streets
achievements.description: Complete all gigs and NCPD Scanner Hustles in Heywood.

steps: Open the map and clear every Gig and NCPD Scanner Hustle marker in Heywood.
Use MapGenie / in-game filters — greyed icons mean unfinished.

achievements.name: Gunslinger
achievements.description: Shoot an enemy grenade in midair with a revolver.

steps: Use a revolver and wait for an enemy grenade throw.
Shoot the grenade in mid-air before it lands — slow-mo cyberware helps.

achievements.name: Frequent Flyer
achievements.description: Find all fast travel dataterms.

steps: Find every fast travel dataterm across Night City and the Badlands.
Tick them off on MapGenie — the achievement unlocks when the last one is discovered.

achievements.name: City Lights
achievements.description: Complete all gigs and NCPD Scanner Hustles in City Center.

steps: Open the map and clear every Gig and NCPD Scanner Hustle marker in City Center.
Use MapGenie / in-game filters — greyed icons mean unfinished.

achievements.name: It's Elementary
achievements.description: Complete all gigs and NCPD Scanner Hustles in Watson.

steps: Open the map and clear every Gig and NCPD Scanner Hustle marker in Watson.
Use MapGenie / in-game filters — greyed icons mean unfinished.

achievements.name: Greetings from Pacifica!
achievements.description: Complete all gigs and NCPD Scanner Hustles in Pacifica.

steps: Open the map and clear every Gig and NCPD Scanner Hustle marker in Pacifica.
Use MapGenie / in-game filters — greyed icons mean unfinished.

achievements.name: Little Tokyo
achievements.description: Complete all gigs and NCPD Scanner Hustles in Westbrook.

steps: Open the map and clear every Gig and NCPD Scanner Hustle marker in Westbrook.
Use MapGenie / in-game filters — greyed icons mean unfinished.

achievements.name: Autojock
achievements.description: Buy all vehicles available for purchase.

steps: Buy every vehicle listed for sale from fixers/websites as you level Street Cred.
Check each district’s vehicle offers — missing one car blocks the unlock.

achievements.name: The Devil
achievements.description: Help Takemura avenge the death of Saburo Arasaka.

steps: Keep Takemura alive through his questline (do not let him die in the story beats that can kill him).
Choose the ending path where you help Takemura avenge Saburo Arasaka.
warnings: Ending-specific — requires the Takemura revenge path. Make saves before the point of no return.

achievements.name: The APB is Not Enough
achievements.description: Become Dogtown's most wanted criminal.

steps: In Dogtown (Phantom Liberty), raise your wanted / bounty with Barghest forces.
Keep fighting Barghest until you hit the maximum Dogtown wanted state.

achievements.name: The Wasteland
achievements.description: Complete all gigs and NCPD Scanner Hustles in the Badlands.

steps: Open the map and clear every Gig and NCPD Scanner Hustle marker in the Badlands.
Use MapGenie / in-game filters — greyed icons mean unfinished.

achievements.name: Relic Ruler
achievements.description: Unlock all Perks in the Relic Perk tree.

steps: In Phantom Liberty, collect all 15 Relic perk points (story gifts + Militech data terminals + ICA areas).
Spend points to unlock every perk in the Relic tree.

achievements.name: Rough Landing
achievements.description: While Berserk cyberware is active, perform a Superhero Landing to kill or incapacitate 2 enemies.

steps: Install Berserk cyberware and activate it.
From a height, perform a Superhero Landing on a group and kill/incapacitate 2 enemies with that landing.

achievements.name: The Tower
achievements.description: Complete "Things Done Changed".

steps: Unlock the Phantom Liberty ending path that leads to “Things Done Changed”.
Complete the quest “Things Done Changed”.

achievements.name: Judgement Day
achievements.description: Eliminate three bosses from the "Increased criminal activity" category.

steps: In Dogtown, clear all three "Increased Criminal Activity" boss sites.
Kill each boss and loot the area rewards.

achievements.name: King of Swords
achievements.description: Take Songbird home.

steps: In Phantom Liberty’s finale branch, take Songbird home (NUSA/Reed path variant).

achievements.name: Daemon In The Shell
achievements.description: Kill or incapacitate 3 enemies with one "Detonate Grenade" quickhack.

steps: Upload Detonate Grenade to enemies who are clustered and carrying grenades.
One Detonate Grenade quickhack must kill/incapacitate 3 enemies (chain in a tight group).

achievements.name: King of Pentacles
achievements.description: Refuse Songbird's request.

steps: Reload your late Phantom Liberty save.
Refuse Songbird's request to unlock this ending achievement.
warnings: Phantom Liberty — mutually exclusive with King of Cups. Save beforehand.

achievements.name: King of Cups
achievements.description: Fulfill Songbird's request.

steps: Play Phantom Liberty to the final Songbird decision.
Fulfill Songbird's request (opposite of Refuse).
warnings: Phantom Liberty — mutually exclusive with King of Pentacles. Save before the final Songbird choice.
